definitions.explanation: A hood attached to a jacket, parka, or hoodie. Pulled up over the head against rain or cold.

definitions.gloss: food (esp. in compounds and brand-style names)
definitions.explanation: Food, used mostly in fixed compounds such as ファストフード, ペットフード, ベビーフード. Rare on its own.

notes:
Two unrelated English loanwords spelled the same in katakana: "hood" and "food." Context — usually whether the word stands alone or appears in a compound — makes the sense clear.

SENSE 1 (hood):
- フード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧: to pull up a hood
- フード⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: hooded (e.g. フード⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パーカー→パーカー：04524_paakaa⟧)
- フード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to push the hood back / take the hood off

SENSE 2 (food, compound use):
- ファストフード: fast food
- ペットフード: pet food
- ベビーフード: baby food
- ドッグフード: dog food
- フード⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧: food court

Used by itself, フード is almost always taken to mean "hood." When the meaning is "food," speakers normally use ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧ or ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧ instead.
